rejectionRules.reason: A candidate in a future phase is not admitted.
A candidate beyond the resolved story-time anchor is not admitted.
Secret foreshadowing remains hidden before its reveal scene or without explicit secret access.
Character-relative knowledge is scoped to its knowledge holder.
Reader knowledge cannot be silently injected into a character context.
An assertion for another audience is not admitted into the current context.
An assertion explicitly scoped to another scene is not admitted.
Assertions from another worldline are not admitted.
Assertions from another timeline are not admitted.
Assertions from another narrative layer are not admitted.
Candidates without a validated explicit scope remain in the review-only lane.
